sources.what: Official: muse exec flags (--json JSONL on stdout, --prompt-file, --session-id, --disable-approval, --yolo, --max-model-steps), exit codes 0/1/2/130/143
Official: approval modes, --disable-approval keeps the sandbox, --yolo drops approval and sandbox and trusts the workspace, sandbox writes and network
Official: install commands, `muse serve` runs the session protocol and `muse schema` prints its JSON schema, default model muse-spark-1.2
Official: META_API_KEY before a stored key before a browser sign-in; `muse auth set`, `muse logout`

Official: releases up to 1.4.2; 1.4.0 a failed exec run shows its reason on the final stderr line, a first run without a terminal names --trust-workspace; 1.4.2 exec returns the run's result when cleanup stalls
Secondhand: the record envelope and payload types (MuseRecord, MusePayload, TaskLifecycleEvent, RunTerminal) and the captured streams under test_cases/ (Muse Code 0.1.0-R708.1)
Secondhand: a captured tool-use stream (write_file, read_file, run.terminal.completed)
